title: SCHC session vector overstates unsupported local key-generation binding
description: test/vectors/schc_session_security.json declares both local_key_generation and remote_key_generation as state-key components, and the SCHC draft says their generation tokens, but Python _AuthenticatedReassemblyManager/SchcSessionManager bind local full public key plus only the remote trust-store generation token. LinkLayer has no live local-key rotation and persistence is restored across a new owner instance, so either the artifact/spec must precisely scope local generation as relevant only to implementations with live local rekey, or Python needs an explicit persisted local-generation model. Resolve the contract and add an assertion that the vector's listed components match executable ownership.
